gen-fs-teko-gf-hepta-slab: Teko comes in tightly set, its strokes like bent steel rod with almost no gaps between letters. And the serif Hepta Slab stretches out wide beneath it, open and uniform in stroke, which is the pair's real strength.
gen-fs-teko-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Teko packs its letters tight, each stroke bent like steel rod with almost no gaps. But Padyakke Expanded One spreads wide, its round bowls keeping uniform walls like a pitcher's mouth.
gen-eater-gf-ubuntu-sans: Ubuntu Sans reads modern and round, its big-eyed lowercase and tubular strokes like bent copper pipe, while Eater growls above. Give Eater generous size so its thin strokes register.
gen-eater-gf-yaldevi: Dark and menacing, Eater snarls across the top with wide gaps. Yaldevi handles the quiet work, with outsized lowercase and an e whose eye opens clearly to the right.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-rejang: Flavors towers on an x-height like a stubby carpenter's pencil stroke, its diagonals carrying the same heft as the stems. Noto Sans Rejang settles in with wide, porthole-like counters to steady the whimsy.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-siddham: Chunky and playful, Flavors stands tall with strokes of constant width, like bent pipe. And Noto Sans Siddham, with a large central band, would read on easily through pages of text.
gen-fs-trench-slab-work-sans: Trench Slab's outsized lowercase gives it an industrial, modern weight right away. Work Sans, the sans-serif below, has strokes of constant width, so a modest size feels right beneath it.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Autour One keeps a tube-like thickness through every bend, with a clear channel into each round letter. Hedvig Letters Sans follows with small letters nearly as tall as capitals, so lines read smoothly.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur reads modern and sturdy, its tall lowercase like stamped metal type, with wide gaps where curves meet stems. Beneath Autour One, a paragraph moves along like a steel cable outline.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-hind-madurai: Loud, round and expressive, Autour One leads with a clear channel into curves. Hind Madurai, the sans-serif beneath, wins mostly by filling the line with capital-tall lowercase and widely opened s curves.
